newsitem.title: USA: ACC Corp sees improved revs, EBITDA margin.
newsitem.headline: ACC Corp sees improved revs, EBITDA margin.

text.p: ACC Corp said on Tuesday that it is anticipating a 35 percent increase in revenues from "internal sources" for 1997.
Also, the company expects a 30 percent increase in margins for earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) to 13 percent of revenues.

ACC, which reported higher fourth quarter revenues and earnings, was not immediately available to describe what "internal sources" means. The company said it has been experiencing double- and triple-digit growth in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom.
ACC said it plans to begin serving customers in Germany during 1997.

ACC anticipates continued improvement in reducing administrative and sales costs as a percentage of revenue through further economies of growth, productivity through new information systems, and the benefits of the company's creation of separate North American and European units.
An ACC Corp spokesman later said internal revenue growth means the company's revenue growth excluding acquisitions.
